description:
Prompt text that isn't a procedure: identity, brand voice, context, policy.

Written as bases/<id>.md: optional YAML front matter, then the text.

agents.description: Agents this block applies to without them opting in. "*" for every agent, or a list of agent ids (file names in agents/) or platform refs like "vapi:asst_9f3e". Empty means only agents that inherit it (bases) or none (SOPs).
agents.title: Agents

exclude.description: Agent ids or platform refs to leave out, even when `agents` matches them.
exclude.title: Exclude

id.description: The file name without .md. Set automatically.
id.title: Id

inherits.description: Other bases placed before this one, wherever this one is used. Parents come first.
inherits.title: Inherits

locked.description: If true, no agent can exclude this base. Use for text that must be in every prompt it targets.
locked.title: Locked

position.description: "top" goes before the agent's instructions; "bottom" goes after the SOPs (e.g. a call closing).
position.title: Position

title: sopc base: front matter of bases/<id>.md
